post.description: Retrieves a paginated list of statuses from accounts the logged-in user follows. Requires a valid auth token.
Creates a follow relationship between the logged-in user and the target user. Requires a valid auth token.
Determines whether one user is currently following another user. Requires a valid auth token.
Removes the follow relationship between the logged-in user and the target user. Requires a valid auth token.
Returns the number of users the specified user is following. Requires a valid auth token.
Retrieves a paginated list of users that the given user is following. Requires a valid auth token.
Returns the number of users following the specified user. Requires a valid auth token.
Retrieves a paginated list of users that follow the given user. Requires a valid auth token.
Posts a new status update for the logged-in user. Requires a valid auth token.
Retrieves a paginated list of statuses created by the specified user. Requires a valid auth token.
Retrieves user details for the given alias. Requires a valid auth token.
Logs out the current user by invalidating the provided auth token.
Authenticates a user using alias and password and returns the corresponding user and a valid auth token.
Creates a new user account, stores the user information, and returns the new user and an auth token.
